Describe this picture by ANSWERING EACH QUESTION with one of the allowed answers and nothing else. Output strict JSON with these keys.
"landform": the shape of the ground, one of flat, gentle rise, hills, mountains, cliffs, indoors.
"people": how many human figures you can see, as a number.
"lookalikes": how many of those figures look like copies of another one (same face, same build, same clothes), as a number.
"text": true if any letters, words, numbers or captions appear anywhere, else false.
"hour": the time of day the LIGHT says, one of day, dusk, night.
"posture": what the MAIN person in the picture is doing with his body, one of standing, walking, running, sitting, crouching, kneeling, lying, none.
"body": is the MAIN person drawn whole, or does the body fade away or dissolve into fog or darkness before the frame edge, one of ok, fading, floating, cannot_tell.
"limb_attached": is every visible hand or arm joined to a body in the picture, or does one float or end in a hard cut with no body, one of ok, fading, floating, cannot_tell.
"fog_cover": does fog or haze hide part of a figure, one of ok, fading, floating, cannot_tell.
"subjects": a list of the things in the picture, each a short plain noun phrase, everything you can name, including anything unexpected.
(ask v2)
